# Hilbert space

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:frameKindHilbert`](gmeow-frameKindHilbert.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/frameKindHilbert>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An inner-product space that is complete with respect to the norm induced by the inner product; may be infinite-dimensional. The ontology models this with [`dimensionCount`](../properties/gmeow-dimensionCount.md) 1 and a single axis, leaving actual dimensionality to solver-layer matrix attributes ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).
